source_name: US EPA National Lakes Assessment (NLA) - Phytoplankton Count Data
sampling_frequency: Typically 1 index sample per lake per survey; some revisits possible
biological_measurements: Phytoplankton taxonomy, abundance, biovolume, density, algal group, phylum/target taxon
environmental_measurements: Extensive water chemistry, physical habitat, secchi, chlorophyll, nutrients, microcystin in separate NLA files
qc_metadata: NLA metadata/method manuals available on EPA site
missingness_gaps: Low temporal resolution per lake; not continuous
licence: US Government public data (verify per file)
provenance: EPA NARS page and direct CSV header check 2026-11-22
notes: Valuable for broad biological/ecological context and method benchmarking; generally unsuitable for Buffalo Pound-style HF early-warning confirmatory evaluation due single-visit survey design.

source_name: Cumbrian Lakes plankton and fish data (1940-2013)
verified_downloadable: Landing page verified; download gated by licence terms
sampling_frequency: Long-term; varies (weekly/fortnightly in some programs) - needs file inspection
biological_measurements: Phyto- and zooplankton counts, chlorophyll; fish catch data
environmental_measurements: Chlorophyll; related CEH datasets have temp/oxygen/chemistry
licence: EIDC licence terms apply; attribution/collaboration note
ecosentinel_suitability: B - Conditional candidate (if access/licence acceptable and HF env data paired)
notes: Long-term biological series is rare and valuable. Requires licence review and pairing with compatible HF environmental data; not cyanobacteria-only.
